title: PR #36990 added the support app's CourseTeamManageAPIView with only IsAuthenticated, without the support-role gate every sibling support view uses, so any learner can probe arbitrary accounts and instructors can read other users' course roles.

findings.explanation: The diff introduces serializers for REST API endpoints. No SQL queries are constructed from user input. The code uses Django ORM (CourseOverview.objects) and serializer methods that work with model instances, not raw SQL strings.

Tests show that instructors can query course information via GET endpoint with 'email' parameter (line 119-129). The test 'test_get_api_instructor_can_only_see_their_courses' suggests filtering by user access, but the actual view implementation is not visible in this diff. Authorization enforcement depends on the view code (not shown). The serializer itself performs no authorization checks.

evidence.content:
def test_get_api_instructor_can_only_see_their_courses(self):
        """GET API: Course instructor sees only courses they have access to."""
        self.client.login(
            username=self.instructor_user.username, password=TEST_PASSWORD
        )
        resp = self.client.get(self.url, {"email": self.user.email})
        self.assertEqual(resp.status_code, 200)

findings.suggested_fix: Verify that the actual view implementation (CourseTeamManageAPIView) properly enforces authorization checks to ensure users can only query/modify courses they have access to. Implement ownership/access control validation before returning course data.

findings.explanation: The PUT endpoint test (test_put_api_missing_email_returns_400) suggests role modification functionality. Authorization for PUT operations (assigning/revoking instructor/staff roles) is not visible in the provided diff. The view implementation that enforces who can modify which roles is missing from this diff.
findings.suggested_fix: Ensure the view implementation enforces strict authorization: only admins/staff should be able to assign instructor/staff roles. Implement role-based access control checks before modifying CourseAccessRole objects.
